item.title: From cybersecurity to AI to Taiwan, what's at stake in Trump's summit with Xi
item.description: As President Trump and China's President Xi prepare to meet, Rush Doshi of the Council on Foreign Relations explains the current state of U.S.-China relations and what to expect from this summit.

item.title: Trump touts his economy and U.S. actions in Iran in UNGA address
item.description: President Trump touted what he portrayed as international and domestic triumphs in a speech to the U.N. General Assembly.

item.title: DOJ defends White House media ban, urges court to reject lawsuit
item.description: The Department of Justice defended President Trump's recent media ban, arguing that reporting by CNN, MS Now and Politico on a wide range of issues jeopardized national security and spread falsehoods.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Major news outlets banned by Trump will have their day in court
item.description: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico are asking a federal judge to hold the president in check for what they say is a violation of their Constitutional rights simply because he doesn't like how they cover him.

item.title: There's growing concern that Trump may deploy the National Guard ahead of elections
item.description: Fears are growing that President Trump may deploy the U.S. military to polling places in the upcoming elections, despite strict state and federal laws against such a move.

item.title: As Congress confronts AI, Senate lawmakers are shut off from its most advanced tools
item.description: While Senate offices have access to chatbots like ChatGPT, they are not authorized to use any of the more advanced tools that are at the center of regulatory talks and public debate about AI safety.

item.title: Poll: Trust in the U.S. Postal Service delivering mail-in ballots on time has fallen
item.description: Registered voters are less confident that USPS will deliver election mail on time compared with 2024, an NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds, after USPS was part of Trump's bid to limit mail voting.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump is on voters' minds in the midterms -- and they're not happy, poll shows
item.description: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds President Trump — and his unpopularity — is an outsize factor in why most voters say they want Democrats to win the midterms.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A look at the legacy and influence Nancy Pelosi will leave behind when she retires
item.description: Rep. Nancy Pelosi will retire following the 2026 midterm elections, ending her almost 40-year career in Congress, but leaving a lasting influence on U.S. politics.
